PRES.description: Pressure Load (PRES). A single ITEMS array of pressure-load objects; ELEM_TYPE (PLATE/PLANE/SOLID) and FACE_EDGE_TYPE (FACE/EDGE/PRES) together drive which of FORCES, EDGE_LOADS and EDGE_FACE apply, and DIRECTION drives whether VECTORS/OPT_PROJECTION apply.

ITEMS.description: Array of pressure-load items. One object per pressure load applied to the element identified by the request key.

ID.description: Serial number of this load item within the element key. 0 lets the program assign it.

LCNAME.description: Static load case name. Must reference an existing load case, or the request is rejected.

GROUP_NAME.description: Load group name. Must reference an existing load group when non-empty; empty string means no group.

CMD.description: Command type (case-insensitive). "PRES" for a pressure load, "HYDRO" for a hydrostatic load.

ELEM_TYPE.description: Element type (case-insensitive). "PLATE" (plate/plane-stress/wall), "PLANE" (axisymmetric/plane-strain), "SOLID". Determines the internal load type: PLATE=1, PLANE=2, SOLID=3.

FACE_EDGE_TYPE.description: Pressure application type (case-insensitive). Constrained by ELEM_TYPE: for PLATE use "FACE" (face pressure) or "EDGE" (edge load); for PLANE only "EDGE" is allowed; for SOLID only "PRES" is allowed.

DIRECTION.description: Load direction (case-insensitive). "NORMAL", "LX"/"LY"/"LZ" (local), "GX"/"GY"/"GZ" (global), or "VECTOR" (user vector via VECTORS).

VECTORS.description: [DIRECTION=VECTOR] Direction vector [X, Y, Z]. Required and must have 3 components when DIRECTION is "VECTOR".

OPT_PROJECTION.description: [DIRECTION=GX/GY/GZ] Projection option; only consulted when DIRECTION is a global axis.

FORCES.description: [FACE_EDGE_TYPE=FACE or PRES] Pressure force array of 5 values. Uniform load: [PU, 0, 0, 0, 0]; linear load: [0, P1, P2, P3, P4]. Required (5 components) for PLATE+FACE and for SOLID+PRES.

EDGE_LOADS.description: [FACE_EDGE_TYPE=EDGE] Edge load array of 3 values. Uniform load: [EPU, 0, 0]; linear load: [0, EP1, EP2]. Required (3 components) for EDGE loads (PLATE+EDGE or PLANE+EDGE).

PSLT_KEY.description: Pressure slot key (used only in specific builds). Leave 0 unless required.

EDGE_FACE.description: Required except for PLATE+FACE. Face or edge index the load is applied to. For SOLID: face #1-#6; for PLATE/PLANE edge loads: edge #1-#4.
